# Cirth v0.8.4

Cirth v0.8.4 finishes what v0.8.3 started: date/time inputs on Firefox
still showed two calendar icons after that release, and this fixes it for
real, with a different approach. No breaking changes.

## Fixed

- **Date/time inputs still showed two calendar icons on Firefox after
  0.8.3** (gh#79) — the 0.8.3 fix used a CSS rule with lower specificity
  than the rule it needed to override, so it silently never applied.
  Cirth's own icon now shows consistently across every date/time field
  type, in every browser, matching Chrome/Safari, instead of deferring
  to Firefox's native icon on `date`/`datetime-local`. Firefox paints
  its native icon via the element's `color`, decoupled from the field's
  actual text glyphs (repainted independently via the non-standard but
  Firefox-supported `-webkit-text-fill-color`), so `color: transparent`
  hides just the icon without hiding the text.

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#084---2026-08-13)
for the complete, itemized list.
